Instinctive Behaviour: If the unit is outside of Synapse range during the Rally phase and has no Battleshock marker, it gains one. This marker can only be removed by being in Synapse range during the next Rally phase. If a unit outside of Synapse range has to flee, it moves towards the closest Synapse unit. Units that start off the board as reserves count as being within Synapse range during the Rally phase.
Psychic Feedback: Whenever a model in your army would roll on the Perils of the Warp table, it instead suffers 1 Mortal Wound.

Shadow in the Warp: Enemy psykers suffer a -1 penalty to manifest and deny psychic powers. Enemy units suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership starting in the 3rd battle round. Both penalties are doubled for enemy units that are within Synapse range.

Synapse: Units with this ability explode like a vehicle upon losing their last Wound.

Units within 12" of a model with this ability are in Synapse range:
- They ignore modifiers to their Leadership value.
- They always count as being at starting strength.
- All Leadership tests are treated as successful, regardless of the result.
- However, if the unit has suffered at least 1 unsaved Wound before taking the test and the result would normally fail, it suffers 1 Mortal Wound for each point by which the result exceeds its Leadership value. The unit does not receive a Battleshock token and is still treated as having passed the Leadership test for all rules purposes.
- They lose all existing Battleshock tokens at the start of the Rally phase.
